events.verdict: Kleber (DAL) exits the paint within three seconds.
White (SAS) reaches in and makes contact to the arm of Doncic (DAL) during his shooting motion that affects his jump shot attempt.
Doncic (DAL) makes hand on ball contact with DeRozan (SAS) during his driving shot attempt and that contact is deemed incidental.
Doncic (DAL) makes incidental contact to the arm of Aldridge (SAS) after the release that does not affect his play at the basket.
Jordan (DAL) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of White (SAS) and doesn't deliver contact.
Matthews (DAL) brings one hand to the opposite side of White's (SAS) body but he immediately removes it.
White (SAS) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Matthews (DAL) and doesn't deliver contact.
Jordan (DAL) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Matthews (DAL) maintains a legal guarding position during the jump shot attempt by DeRozan (SAS).
Forbes (SAS) gives Doncic (DAL) room to land on the jump shot attempt.
Bertans (SAS) makes incidental contact with Kleber's (DAL) neck/head area during the rebound.
Doncic (DAL) commits a take foul on Forbes (SAS).
Doncic (DAL) commits a take foul on Belinelli (SAS).
White (SAS) places a hand/arm to the front of Doncic (DAL) on the drive and the contact affects his SQBR.
DeRozan (SAS) brings one hand to the opposite side of Barnes' (DAL) body but he slides it off as Barnes (DAL) moves away.
DeRozan (SAS) places a hand/arm to the front of Doncic (DAL) at the start of the drive but he is able to move through the contact and continue his drive.
